display.title: Episode 143: The Secret of the Empty Fireplace (Rosh Hashanah)
display.summary_short: On the eve of Rosh Hashanah, Uncle Yossi explains why it is the 'head' of the year and tells how the young Tzemach Tzedek hid in a fireplace to hear his grandfather teach Torah; plus a shofar demonstration.
display.summary_long: Broadcast the day before Erev Rosh Hashanah. Uncle Yossi gives the Yom Tov candle-lighting details, then shares the Mitteler Rebbe's explanation in Ateres Rosh: the holiday is called the 'head' of the year, not merely its beginning, because like the head it gives life to every day that follows, so we must daven and behave with special care. He speaks about Selichos and good resolutions. After the Hakochainik march and a sponsor message, a nine-year-old girl leads the Shema. Because Erev Rosh Hashanah is the birthday of the Tzemach Tzedek, story time tells how, as a boy of nine too young to join his grandfather the Alter Rebbe's private lessons, he secretly crawled into the empty fireplace to listen. One cold evening the butler lit the fire; the boy was pulled out motionless, and revived only when the Alter Rebbe laid his hand on his head. A guest then demonstrates the shofar's tekiah, shevarim and teruah. The show closes with a reminder to hear the shofar both days, the contest extended until after Sukkos, and a refuah shleimah request.
display.lesson: Love Torah so much that you would do anything to learn more; and make Rosh Hashanah, the head of the year, a healthy head for the whole year.
